picture-pairs.name: Oviperendero mbi sana
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Omunyando wokuhasana oviperendero kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka: Oviperendero mbi Sana
picture-pairs.h1: Oviperendero mbi Sana: Omunyando omuporote wokuhasana
picture-pairs.description: Omunyando womure omuporote wokuhasana oviperendero kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka. Oviperendero ovinene vi kara oviyeuke apehe, kapena otjiwiri poo omaraneno, nu mo sokutoorora otuvara 4 nga 12.
picture-pairs.short: Vaza oviperendero vivari mbi sana pamwe. Oviperendero vi yenena okukara vi munika apehe.
picture-pairs.intro: Tonya kotjiperendero, nu tji pa piti opo o tonya kwihi tji tji sana na tjo. Oviperendero vi kara oviyeuke oukahu, ngandu aaku kapena tji matji hepa okuzemburukwa. Tji pwa sana oviperendero vivari, vi pewa omukoka wokangondo nokamanyikiso kokuina.
howTo: Toorora otukonde tji tji ri po. Otukonde tune oruveze oruporote rwokutaara.
Tonya kotjiperendero ngamwa atjihe. Tji pewa omukoka wokangondo.
Tonya kotjiperendero tji tji sana na tjo. Ovivari vi kaza pamwe nokamanyikiso kokuina.
Tji vi ri pekepeke, kapena otjihihameno tji tji tjitwa. Tonya rukwao ngunda u ri tyike.
Munisa "Oviperendero mbya horeka" ngunda amuhe aveve amu yakura omukaro oukuru wovipapera mbi tondama.
tips: Tamuna oviperendero kounene pamwe nu amu hungire kombinga yavyo: "Etemba rokopi etjize. Ove u nwa omavele motee?"
Yandjera omundu ngu u tekura ma tonye mwini, nandarire tji ma ku kutu oruveze. Ulike nongunino pendje nokumutonyena.
Karee notukonde tune ngunda atji tji uwa. Otukonde ovingi eororero kaku ri ondondo yokuvaza.
Manena ngunda atji ri ombango ondengu. Omunyando umwe otjitjitwa otjirungamene.

faq.q: Pena otjiwiri tjoruveze poo omaraneno?
faq.a: Koko. Kapena otjiwiri, omaraneno wondando, okubarurisa omahinano poo okutoniswa. Mo yenene okusuva potuveze ngamwa atuhe, nu okusuva pokati ongondorero osemba yokumanena.

faq.q: Oviperendero ovikenya mbi zikira ovirarere?
faq.a: Okuyandjera oviperendero vi munike ku tjita kutja omunyando au kare wokutara nokuhasana pendje nokuzemburuka. Ovandu ovangi ve vaza kutja ihi otjiporote tjinene. Mo yenene okupindukira koviperendero mbya horeka motutonye ngamwa umwe tji u vanga.

faq.q: Itji tjomure, nu mbi hepa okurisirisisa?
faq.a: Iiyo, otjomure, nu kapena omaisasaneno, erisirisiso poo okutorora. Matji ungura moukuhukise woyeva kongodji, otableta poo okompiuta.

faq.q: Matu yenene okuungurisa omapeka weṱe oveni veṱundu?
faq.a: Iiyo. Rora Omapeka mbi sana, ngu me ku yandjere okutoorora omapeka motjitungi tjoye. Omapeka ye zikira moukuhukise woye nungwari ka ye twawa koutjiwike.

find-the-same.name: Vaza tji tji sana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Vaza Otjiperendero Tji Tji Sana: Omunyando Omupuku kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka
find-the-same.description: Otjiperendero tjimwe kombanda, vivari nga vine kehi. Tonya kwihi tji tji sana na tjo. Omunyando womure omuporote woviperendero kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka, aape he ri otjiwiri.
find-the-same.short: Tara otjiperendero tji tji ri kombanda nu o tonye kwihi tji tji sana na tjo kehi.
find-the-same.intro: Otjiperendero tjimwe tji kara kombanda yotjitarero. Kehi yatjo pena oviperendero vivari, vitatu poo vine. Tonya kwihi tji tji sana na tjo. Etoororo rimwe epuku poruveze rumwe, noruveze oruingi rwokuhungira.
howTo: Toorora oviperendero vivari, vitatu poo vine mbi u toora mu vyo. Vivari ovipuku tjinene.
Tareye otjiperendero tji tji ri kombanda pamwe.
Tonya kotjiperendero tji tji sana na tjo kehi. Tji zemburukwa nokamanyikiso kokuina nomambo ombahu.
Tji pwa tonywa otjiperendero tjarwe, omunyando u tamuna ena ratjo uriri nu aundju. Kaa handunuke.
Tonya "Otjiperendero tji matji kongorere" tji wa zikamene tjarwe.
tips: Hungireye kombinga yotjiperendero atjihe ngunda amu he ya toorora: omirari vyovakara, ovihape, noruveze amu tji muna.
Ovihororwa vivari kavi ri "ovipuku kounene". Ondando oruveze oruwa, nungwari kaku ri erorero.
Tji pe nomauzeu wokutonya, omundu ma yenene okuurika nongunino nu ove otonyere po.

faq.q: Pena otjiwiri tjoruveze poo omaraneno?
faq.a: Koko. Kapena otjiwiri, omaraneno wondando, okubarurisa omahinano poo okutoniswa. Mo yenene okusuva potuveze ngamwa atuhe, nu okusuva pokati ongondorero osemba yokumanena.

faq.q: Otjike tji tji tjitwa tji pwa tonywa otjiperendero tji he ri tjo?
faq.a: Kapena otjihihameno natjimwe. Kapena orutoni, omukorosi omutjize poo okuengenga. Omunyando u tamuna otjiperendero tji tji twa tonywa nu au undju etonyo etenga.

faq.q: Itji tjomure, nu mbi hepa okurisirisisa?
faq.a: Iiyo, otjomure, nu kapena omaisasaneno, erisirisiso poo okutorora. Matji ungura moukuhukise woyeva kongodji, otableta poo okompiuta.

shadow-match.name: Okuhepera omuzire
shadow-match.seoTitle: Omunyando wokuhasana omizire kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka: Womure kOintaneta
shadow-match.description: Omuzire omumbwimbwi kombanda, oviperendero vivari nga vine kehi. Tonya kotjiperendero tji tji tjita omuzire mbo. Omunyando womure omuporote wokuhasana omizire kwoovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka, aape he ri otjiwiri.
shadow-match.short: Tara komuzire nu o tonye kotjiperendero tji tji u tjita.
shadow-match.intro: Okuhepera omuzire otjitjitwa tji tji tjiukwa nawa okuza komapapera womanyando, mba pe noviperendero ovinene nu kapena tji matji purintwa. Omuzire omuporote u ri kombanda yotjitarero nu oviperendero vivari, vitatu poo vine vi undja kehi. Tonya kwihi tji tji tjita omuzire. Ovihape tjimuna okambasikera, otjiwambarara poo etemba rotee ovipuku okuhungirira po pamwe.
howTo: Toorora oviperendero vivari, vitatu poo vine mbi u toora mu vyo. Vivari ovipuku tjinene.
Tareye omuzire pamwe. Orupe ru ri vi? Orusehame poo oruringine?
Tonya kotjiperendero tji tji tjita omuzire. Ena ratjo mari munika kehi yomuzire.
Tji pwa tonywa otjiperendero tjarwe, omunyando u tamuna ena ratjo uriri nu aundju. Kaa handunuke.
Tonya "Omuzire tji mau kongorere" tji wa zikamene urwe.
tips: Hina kongorera omukoka womuzire nomunwe nu amu hungire kombinga yorupe.
Tji omizire mavi munika ovizeu ndino, pindukira ku Vaza tji tji sana, ku ku kara oviperendero mbi sana kourira.
Hungireye kombinga yotjiperendero tji tja vazewa: "Eṱe twa ri notjiwambarara tjimuna ihi."

faq.q: Pena otjiwiri tjoruveze poo omaraneno?
faq.a: Koko. Kapena otjiwiri, omaraneno wondando, okubarurisa omahinano poo okutoniswa. Mo yenene okusuva potuveze ngamwa atuhe, nu okusuva pokati ongondorero osemba yokumanena.

faq.q: Okupatanisa omitunhu noviperendero ouwa kovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka?
faq.a: Matji sokukara otjiungura omatjatje nu otjipupu kovandu vamwe, unene pomautiro womauzeu ingo. Omitunhu ovikukutu vi parapara okuzemburukwa pu nomambo. Ovitjiungura viovyo vyokumuna onyanya nomizambero, katjiri omatwiriro wezeu, nu kavitjevere poo okukakaterisa oukekombepo wokuzemburuka. Tji tjeeta omanyando, rorera ko Okumuna otjingeto poo tara koviperendero pamwe uriri.

faq.q: Tjike tji tji tjitwa tji pa kumiwa otjiperendero tji he ri tjo?
faq.a: Kapena otjiṋa tji tjikumisa poo tji tji uvisa omihihamo. Kapena omitunu vyokunwisa, otjikuruse otjizeru poo okuningina. Otjinyandwa matji tamene otjiperendero tji tja kumiwa nu matji undjire kokukuma ku komurungu.

faq.q: Otjotjomahala, nu me hepa okulirisaerisa?
faq.a: Iiyo, otjotjomahala, nu kapena okaundi, okulirisaerisa poo okunanena pehi. Matji ungura mouparanyene worungovi rongodji, otablete poo okombuyuta.

sort-together.name: Hangunurire pamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Otjinyandwa tjokuhangunura tjo vazeu wokuzemburuka: Hangunurire pamwe
sort-together.description: Kuma otjiperendero, ngono o kumu otjimbale mu tji sokuhina: mokombitha poo motjikunino, ovihape poo ovimuna. Otjiungura otjiporote nu otjotjomahala tjokuhangunura kovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka.
sort-together.short: Tura otjiperendero atjihe motjimbale tjatjo: kombitha poo tjikunino, na vyarwe mbya kapitako.
sort-together.intro: Okuhangunura ootjiungura tjo paye tji tji tjiukwa nawa nu tji tjieta ombwaneno, tjimuna okutura oviungurisiwa komavanda poo okuripa ovindjato pekepeke. Kuma otjiperendero, ngono o kumu otjimbale mu tji sokuenda. Kapena okuhahizika nu kapena ondjira ya popi.
howTo: Toora otjiungura: okombitha notjikunino, ovihape novimuna, poo monganda nouyenda.
Kuma otjiperendero. Matji kondo noutjiwa wotjingorodo.
Kuma otjimbale mu tji hepa okuyenda. Otjiperendero matji twara motjimbale ngo.
Tji tji hepa okuyenda motjimbale tjikwao, otjinyandwa matji raere noupore nu tji undjire.
Tji pe manuka okuhangunurwa oviperendero avihe, tareye pamwe movimbale mbyo.
tips: Mouparanga womuhoko kape nomaziriro omapopi. Omundu tji ma tja otjikotora tjomeva tji hepa okukara mokombitha, pura kutja ongwaye. Mape ya o munu ehokololo ewa.
Ungurisa oviperendero okuhinda ozombongarero: "Ove wa kurisa tjike motjikunino tjoye?"
Okuhangunura oviungurisiwa tyatyi, tjimuna omatoo nozondjupa poo ozombando kolukara rwazo, ouwa u tja vi koutara peke nombapara.

faq.q: Pe notjivareki tjomurungu poo ozombano?
faq.a: Kako. Kapena oiri, ozombano, omavarero wovirunduriro poo okunyandwa. Move ya okupwisa oruveze aruhe, nu okuzira pokati oondjira ombwa yo kumanisa.

faq.q: Ongwaye okuhangunura?
faq.a: Ovandu ovengi ve yorokera okuhangunura orondu matji munika tjimuna otjiungura tji tji tjiukwa nawa. Nu wina oshipupu okuhungira koviperendero ngunda mu li motjiungura.

faq.q: Otjotjomahala, nu me hepa okulirisaerisa?
faq.a: Iiyo, otjotjomahala, nu kapena okaundi, okulirisaerisa poo okunanena pehi. Matji ungura mouparanyene worungovi rongodji, otablete poo okombuyuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Otjinyandwa tjotjiperendero
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Otjinyandwa tjotjiperendero otjipupu tjovazeu wokuzemburuka: Oupese 4 poo 9
picture-puzzle.description: Otjinyandwa tjotjiperendero tjokungovi otjipupu kovandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzemburuka: oupese ovatano ovakananḓu 4 poo 9, otjiperendero atjihe matji kara tji munika, nu mo kumu oupese vevari okuzipinganisa.
picture-puzzle.short: Kuma oupese vevari okuzipinganisa nganduu otjiperendero atjihe tji tja koma pamwe.
picture-puzzle.intro: Otjiperendero otjiwa tji ketwa moupesi ovakananḓu vine poo ymuwe nu atji wirasanyiwa. Otjiperendero atjihe matji munika kombanda tjimuna omuhongere. Kuma kapese kamwe, o kumu karwe, nu owo mave pinganisa ovikaro. Kapena ehepero rokunana.
howTo: Toora otjiperendero noupese 4 poo 9. Vine omatangero omaporote.
Tara kotjiperendero atjihe peke kombanda.
Kuma kapese, ngono o kumu poruveze pu ka sokukara. Oupese vevari mave pinganisa.
Oupese mbu wa kara poruveze rwawo pouwa mave kondo notjiraisiro otjititi.
Otjiperendero tji tja koma, nyandeye pamwe, ngono amu toora tjarwe.
tips: Okukuma oupese vevari okuzipinganisa otjipupu unene kombanda yokunana kovandu ovengi.
Hungireye kotjiperendero tji matji komasanyiwa: "Otyo tjihehero otjizeru tjeri peina."
Otjinyandwa tjotjiperendero tjiti tji nomiti vyo 12 nganduu 24 wina otjiungura otjiporote kotjitaavere.

faq.q: Pe notjivareki tjomurungu poo ozombano?
faq.a: Kako. Kapena oiri, ozombano, omavarero wovirunduriro poo okunyandwa. Move ya okupwisa oruveze aruhe, nu okuzira pokati oondjira ombwa yo kumanisa.

faq.q: Mbi sokunana oupese?
faq.a: Kako. Kuma kapese kamwe, ngono o kumu karwe, nu owo mave pinganisa ovikaro. Ihi otjipupu tji pe neke rimwe tji ri ningina poo kokatara okaṱiṱi.

faq.q: Otjotjomahala, nu me hepa okulirisaerisa?
faq.a: Iiyo, otjotjomahala, nu kapena okaundi, okulirisaerisa poo okunanena pehi. Matji ungura mouparanyene worungovi rongodji, otablete poo okombuyuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Mana otjiheve
finish-the-saying.description: Oviheve mbi tjiukwa nawa mbya hepa embo erikotokero, tjimuna "A penny saved is a penny ___". Kuma etooro poo raisa emano rwayo, ngono amu hungire ko.
finish-the-saying.short: Maneye oviheve mbi mwa yeva pamwe, ngono amu hungire ko.
finish-the-saying.intro: Oviheve vyonare oruvingi vi tjiukwa omuinyo auhe. Okakarata akehe ka raisa otjiheve tji tji tjiukwa nawa tji tja pumbwa embo ra koka pehi, omatoorero yetatu, nekonde ro "Raisa emano". Kombunda yemano, epuriro eporote mari nwine omahungi.
howTo: Leseye otjiheve pamwe nomundu mukwenyu noutukiriro.
Kuma embo ndi ma ri mana otjiheve, poo kuma "Raisa emano".
Leseye otjiheve atjihe rukwao nu amu hungire koutire wokukuma.
Kuma "Otjiheve tji ma tji landere" tji mwa rire nawa.
tips: Lesa nahuhu nu u tare oruvingi ngunda ohiyakurisa embo rokotokero. Ovingi ovandu ve ri tona ngunda o hinamane.
Omundu tji ma yandja emano peke, riyandjereye kuro. Omitango vyoviheve vimwe vi pongoroka pokati komapanga poo orukondwa.
Motjimbumba, omundu umwe ma lesa nu avehe mave hepa okuza pamwe kemano.

faq.q: Pe notjivareki tjomurungu poo ozombano?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Indu tji twatoorora embo rarwe?
faq.a: Onyando mai raisa emaneno nga pa tjiukwa nu aihingi komurungu nomuhungiro. Kakuna outa, neziriro rarwe oro eri nawa.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

word-search.name: Okupaha omambo momasorondondo omanene
word-search.seoTitle: Okupaha Omambo momasorondondo Omanene kOvandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzembako, i piritwa
word-search.description: Onyando yowala yokupaha omambo momasorondondo omanene kovanene novandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzembako. Omambo omaṱiti, omaso omanene, omambo mayerwa porweyo nokehi erike. Nyanda kointaneta poo piritisa.
word-search.short: Omasorondondo omanene, omambo omaṱiti, porweyo nokehi erike. Piritisa wina.
word-search.intro: Orukaze orutiṱi ndu nomasorondondo omanene nomambo omaṱiti uriri, aehe mayerwa porweyo poo nokehi. Nya eposiro etenga rembo, okuzambo unya eposiro rayo rokumanina. Mo vanga ombapira? Piritisa onyando ombe monyanyo imwe.
howTo: Toorora otjiungura nongaro yorukaze.
Tara komutanda womambo. Omambo mayerwa porweyo (kumoho kokuoko kokunene) poo nokehi (kombanda kuya kehi).
Nya eposiro etenga rembo, okuzambo unya eposiro rayo rokumanina.
Embo ndi maraara mariraisiwa nu aridikwamo momutanda.
Nya "Piritisa onyando indji" kutja u nyande kombapira nopeni poo opensela.
tips: Raisa embo momutanda nu mu pahe eposiro rarjo etenga pamwe.
Kombapira, openi yomara ohepu okukwata kombanda yopensela.
Hungireye komambo wotjiungura hi. Omambo womiti vyokurya ondjiro yombwa yokupatununa omazemburukiro wokutora, okuteleka poo komatara.

faq.q: Pena oiri poo outa?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Mbi yenene okupiritisa okupaha kwomambo oku?
faq.a: Ii. Nya "Piritisa onyando indji" okupiritisa orukaze rwanambano momasorondondo omanene, nomutanda womambo kehi yaro. Onyando ombe aihe ya panguka.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

coloring.name: Omapandja wokurambika omara
coloring.seoTitle: Omapandja Wokurambika Omara kOvakuru mbe nomauzeu wokuzembako (Yowala)
coloring.description: Omapandja omapu wokurambika omara wovakuru nge nomahina omanene: nya ovara, okuzambo unya otjisurande. Kakuna ondovazu, kakuna ovara ehavi, nepandja arihe ri piritwa owala.
coloring.short: Nya ovara, okuzambo unya orupa rwotjisurande. Piritisa omapandja wina.
coloring.intro: Omapandja nge nomitiro ovinene nu ovipepuke: ongono motee, ondjuwo, okakopi kotyee, ombapira nowato. Nya ovara, okuzambo unya orupa rwotjisurande okurizuzisa. Kakuna omara ehavi.
howTo: Toorora epandja.
Nya ovara. Ovara arihe rena ena rarjo ra sjangwapo.
Nya orupa rwotjisurande okurizuzisa novara mbo.
Rundurura ombango yoye moruveze aruhe mokuzuzisa rukwao.
Nya "Piritisa epandja ndi" okupeta epandja erirangata okurambika nopensela poo openi.
tips: Yandja omara yevari wokutoororapo komurungu yomara ayehe indu okutoorora tji maku munika auri ku tumba.
Omiti vyoviola nomatango wousorere oviwa uriri. Ihi otjokutara komanyando womara, kape nousemba wopoutende.
Omapandja nga piritwa yaungura nawa noopeni omazeu poo outende wokurambika, mbi hepu okukwata momake.

faq.q: Pena oiri poo outa?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Omapandja nga owoutuku tjinene?
faq.a: Twa sura oviṋa ovihoze nu ovipepuke moruveze rwootjatji, kutja omapandja ye yane kovakuru. Omitiro ovinene vi tjita kutja okurambika omara ku kare ouhepu aahiri tjitwa otjoviṋa vyovanatje.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Outuha twomuhungiro
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Omapatununiro Womuhungiro kOvandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzembako: Outuha twOvisurande
conversation-cards.description: Outuha twozisurande mbu nomapatununiro ovihoze vyomuhungiro kovanene novandu mbe nomauzeu wokuzembako: kakuna omapuriro womarorero, kakuna omayandjiro omasemba woposyo. Ungurisa kosikrina poo piritisa otjiungura atjihe.
conversation-cards.short: Outuha twozisurande mbu nomapuriro omapatunuke nu ovihoze. Kakuna omarorero.
conversation-cards.intro: Kahuze kayehe kena otjisurande tji tjiukwa pamwe nombatero yokuhepa okuhungira, otja "Oombepo zaye nde ku ningira komutima?" Kakuna omayandjiro omasemba nu kakuna otjiṋa tji mo hepa okuzemburuka. Toorora otjiungura poo hanganisa aehe pamwe.
howTo: Toorora otjiungura, poo tura pu "Outuha aehe".
Lesa epuriro kombanda nu mu tare kotjisurande pamwe.
Zuva, handja ezuvire roye omuini, nu mu yandjere omuhungiro uhinge nawina.
Nya "Kahuze komurungu" tji wa ripurire, poo kara pamwe nokahuze kamwe oruveze ndu wa vanga.
Nya "Piritisa outuha aehe" okutenda orukondwa rwombapira.
tips: Zira epuriro ove omuini wina. Iri tjiukwa otjomuhungiro, aahi otjopuriro tyomatatere.
Konga ehungi, kape notjiṋa noviṋa viozondunge zotjili uriri. Oviṋa tji vya runduruka, iho otjiwa uriri.
Kahuze tji ka kutura otjiṋa tji tji nomuinyo omuzandu, yakura ombango ndjo nu mu hinge nawa kokahuze karwe.

faq.q: Ongwaye tji ku hina omapuriro nga "Mo zemburuka...?"
faq.a: Omapuriro nge rora omazemburukiro ye yenene okumunika aayo omarorero nu aye eta ohoni. Omapatununiro nga "Mbutira ohunga na..." ye yandjera omundu auhe okuhangana momuhungiro, kehi yomazemburukiro we.

faq.q: Mbi yenene okupiritisa outuha?
faq.a: Ii. "Piritisa outuha aehe" i piritisa otjiungura atjihe momasorondondo omanene, outuha ouvingi kepandja rimwe, aari ripurire okutendwa.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, otjo tjipereta tjimwe, nu kapena o-akhauti, omerisasaneno poo okutoora ko. Tji ungura momburausa yongongo mongodi, motablet poo mokompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Oviperendero mbi patasana
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Ungura Otjinyando Tjokupatasana novi-oto vyOmbwaneno yOye
photo-pairs.h1: Oviperendero mbi Patasana: Patasisa ovi-oto vyOye Omuini
photo-pairs.description: Tjita ovi-oto vyombwaneno yoye omuini vi rire otjinyando omatjire tjokupatasana. Toorora ovi-oto 2 nga ku 6 motjirungura tjoye; vi kara momburausa yoye nu kavina pu vi tuminwa koutjiro.
photo-pairs.short: Toorora ovi-oto vyoye omuini nu vi patasise. Kapena tji tuminwa koutjiro.
photo-pairs.intro: Toorora ovi-oto vi vari nga ku vi hamboumwe mongodi yoye, tablet poo mokompiuta, nu vi rire otjinyando tjokupatasana novi-oto ovinene mbi munika nawa. Ovi-oto vi munika moperendero ndwi uriri. Kavi tuminwa koutjiro, kavi tuurwa orure poo okutjindilwa kowarwe, nu vi zemburuka kure indu tji wa pata epandja.
howTo: Twa omunwe pu "Toorora ovi-oto" nu u toorore ovi-oto vi vari nga ku vi hamboumwe.
Otji-oto atjihe tji munika ruvari. Twa omunwe putjimwe, okuzambo twa omunwe potjikwao tji tji patasana natjo.
Hungirei kombinga yotji-oto atjihe ngunda amu tji munu.
Indu tji mwa manuka, pata epandja ndwi poo twa omunwe pu "Isako ovi-oto". Kapena tji tji tuurwa orure.
tips: Toorora ovi-oto mbi munika nawa vyoviṋa vyosorote nombwaneno: okanamuinyo kombo, otjikunino, oruveze ndu hoza tjinene, poo eyuva lyokuhukisirwa.
Oviperendero vyomavaze noviṋa vi yenena okurira oupepu pu omarama wovandu, nu vi ekeza omuhingo wokutokomisa omundu okutumbula omana wovandu.
Essa ovi-oto vyovandu mba koka tji mape ya avi eta oruhoze rotjivarero, ngatu tji mo tjiwa nawa kutja vi eta omuhoko nombepo ombwaneno.

faq.q: Ovi-oto vyandje vi tuminwa pu rimwe koutjiro?
faq.a: Kako. Epandja rilesa ovi-oto mbi wa toorora motjirungura tjoye omuini nu vi raisa posikirini yoye. Kavi tuminwa ketwe poo komundu warwe auhe, nu vi pwa po indu tji wa pata poo okututa epandja rukwao.

faq.q: Pena o-iri yoruveze poo ombaro yomanaku?
faq.a: Kako. Kapena o-iri, ombaro, omatjindiriro poo okutaura. U yenena okupa oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga, nu okupa pokati omuano omumbwa tjinene wokumanuka.

faq.q: Mbi yenena okutjangira otjinyando oruveze tji matji ya?
faq.a: Komburausa yako, otja tji tja ungurwa opo pahe ku ha tuurwa oviṋa vyoye vyouriri. Okambapira ka Golden Moments kokuha-futa ka iPhone na iPad ka yenena okutuura ovi-oto mbi wa toorora motjirungura tjoye.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo yoviperendero
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo yOviperendero yOvakurupe mbe nOmbazu yOkuimbwa: Otjipurintwa
picture-bingo.description: Bingo yoviperendero yokuhepa efuto yokupurinda yotjimbumba tjovakurupe nomatjeverero wozondangero, nomuraisire omuinene posikirini. Oviperendero ovinene pamwe nomambo, ozosikuere 9 poo 16, kapena hepero yokulesa.
picture-bingo.short: Otukarta twobingo twoviperendero twokupurinda nomuraisire woposikirini onene yotjimbumba.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo yotjiposa novi-oto komurungu womano, opo ape ha kara omundu ngu ma lesa otutwiti. Purinda otukarta pekepeke, nu u ungurise omuraisire woposikirini okuraisa otji-oto atjihe tjinene po-TV, laptop poo tablet.
howTo: Toorora ozosikuere 9 poo 16 kokarta akehe na indu kutja penovanyande vengapi.
Twa omunwe pu "Purinda otukarta". Okarta akehe peke na kako.
Patulura omuraisire posikirini onene. Twa omunwe pu "Otji-oto tji tji landako" okuraisa otji-oto atjihe pamwe nena ratjo.
Ovanyande vasivisa otji-oto tji tji patasana kokarta kawo nosente, ombopi poo otjitwaye.
Auhe ngu ma urisa omukweyo, poo okarta akehe, u muna omarangariro. Kapena ovataure momuano mbwi: kayende komurungu nokunyanda nganduu auhe a kare nomukweyo.
tips: Ungurisa ovitwaye ovinene tjimuna outji wokunyandisa poo ovikupiko vyozondjupa. Ombopi ozotwiti mazi yenene okutinda okutoora.
Tumbula ena rotjiperendero nu u hungire tjimwe kombinga yatjo: "Owoato yomeva. Ouṋi ngwa kondere mo-woato?"
Hakarisa ovandu mbe nomatendo wokumuna popezi nosikirini, nu u kute ovavatere pamwe novanyande mbe hepa ombatero.
Ozosikuere omuvyu ozingi rotjimbumba otjiingi. Kara noruveze rwominute 20 nga ku 30 uriri.

faq.q: Mbi tjiti vi bingo yoviperendero monganda yomatjeverero?
faq.a: Purinda okarta kamwe komunyande auhe, tura omuraisire posikirini onene ndji u na yo, nu u isane oviperendero katiti katiti, amutumbula ena ra tjihe. Nyandei nganduu auhe a mune omukweyo, opo ape ha siwa omundu kombunda.

faq.q: Okatjipereta okupurinda?
faq.a: Ii. Purinda otukarta otuingi otja tji mo hepa, oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga, kombwaneno yoye omuini poo yotjimbumba.

faq.q: Ovandu mave yenena okunyanda nokuhina okulesa?
faq.a: Ii. Osikuere aihe otjiperendero otjinene, pamwe nena ratjo kehi ya tjo kwoowo mbe vanga omambo.

calm-breathing.name: Omusuwiro wombepo ombwaneno
calm-breathing.description: Oruveze rwomusuwiro ombwaneno nowakwi wokuhanewa: orungoneno orwongundiparise ru kura nu aru teka momisuwiro ihamuhawe. Ove u tji uta, nu u yenena okupa oruveze aruhe.
calm-breathing.short: Orungoneno orwongundiparise rwokusuvira pamwe natjo. Uta nu u pe oruveze ndu wa vanga.
calm-breathing.intro: Pena oruveze pu tji ri nawa okusuva katiti mwakwi. Twa omunwe pu "Uta", okuzambo hita nomuinyo indu orungoneno tji maru kuru nu u pise omupo indu tji maru teka. Toorora omusuwiro womangovindo poo wouparise. Ka muti wonduriro, omuhingo wombepo yomuhoko wokuhanewa uriri.
howTo: Kuramei nawa noutjire oruvingo noruvingo.
Toorora omusuwiro: womangovindo poo wouparise.
Twa omunwe pu "Uta". Hita nomuinyo indu orungoneno tji maru kuru, nu u pise indu tji maru teka.
Tji ripa owini kombunda yomisuwiro ihamuhawe, poo u twe omunwe pu "Peka" oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga.
tips: Kwatei komaoko poo u ture eke keoko romundu ngu u tjevera tji tji ri nawa ku ye.
O kakondjisa. Tji mave vanga okutara uriri, otjo tji ri nawa.
Tji pe nomundu ngu nomizeze momusuwiro, nga suve oukukutu nu a tare korungoneno uriri. Pura kondjita kombinga yomizeze ayohe yomusuwiro.

faq.q: Ihi otjinyando tjounganga tjomusuwiro?
faq.a: Kako. Oruveze oruhape uriri rwombepo nomuhoko. Keri epango romuinyo omuserekarise poo omutjise auhe. Hungira nondjita kombinga yozongendo zourumbu woye.

faq.q: Orungoneno maru rinyanga aapo ami hima uta?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna tji matji nyinganyinga nga tji wa tona Start, nu matji kurama kombunda yomahihero hamboumwe poo tji wa tona Stop. Tji ebe otjiungurisiwa tjoye tja terekwa okututura omahenyo, omambo maye runduruka aapo otjimbulungundu katji kurire ko.

faq.q: Hapo otjotjali, nu mbi hepa okuritjangisa?
faq.a: Ii, otjotjali, nu kakuna okaawundi, okuritjangisa poo okunanena mo. Matji ungura mombrowser yoweve mongodji, motablet poo mokompiyuta.
